ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Cineline India Limited has successfully completed the preferential allotment and conversion of 3,846,153 warrants into equity shares, injecting approximately ₹33.75 Crores into the company's capital. This transaction significantly increases the company's paid-up share capital and total equity shares, resulting in an estimated 10.2% dilution for non-participating shareholders. The conversion was largely driven by the promoter group and a key non-promoter investor, indicating continued commitment and capital support.
